library(tidyverse)
## FAO data, some of the zeros were originally reported as NA (so exercise caution there)
harvest <- read_csv(“https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OHI-Science/ohiprep_v2025/refs/heads/main/globalprep/mar/v2025/output/mar_harvest_tonnes.csv”)
mex_harvest <- filter(harvest, rgn_id == 135)
mex_harvest <- filter(mex_harvest, year == 2023) %>% data.frame()
# data from Seafood Watch (Monteray Bay)
sustainability <- read_csv(“https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OHI-Science/ohiprep_v2025/refs/heads/main/globalprep/mar/v2025/output/mar_sustainability.csv”)
mex_sust <- filter(sustainability, taxa_code %in% mex_harvest$taxa_code) %>%
 filter(year==2025) %>% data.frame()
# determine whether sustainability was gapfilled (if so, fairly low confidence, depending on method used and taxa)
gf <- read_csv(“https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OHI-Science/ohiprep_v2025/refs/heads/main/globalprep/mar/v2025/output/mar_sustainability_gf.csv”)
mex_gf <- filter(gf, taxa_code %in% mex_harvest$taxa_code) %>% data.frame()
